{{Top|leg}}
A '''passenger ferry''' was a small [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used for passenger transport. During the initial construction of the secret base on [[Tel III]] that would become [[Oracle Base]], the quarter compartments were modules taken from passenger ferries and [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]].
